# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Snackle Quest: Kawaii Block Builder**, a portrait-first mobile browser building game. Preserve the implemented first-person sandbox block mechanics: D-pad movement, right-screen look drag, jump, raycast mining, adjacent block placement, inventory counts, bedrock protection, invalid-action feedback, fall game-over, pause/resume, restart, and touch-friendly controls.

Reinterpret the loop through this prompt: Building Game. A satirical game inspired by Zelda built around block builder play, with puzzle, creative, one more level energy, lunch break session design, search-friendly hooks like block builder, building game, casual, aesthetics like kawaii, pastel dream, popcore, and meme-tone cues such as its giving, no thoughts head empty. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The public surface should feel like a satirical Zelda-adjacent lunch shrine: a tiny hero-builder wanders a pastel dream voxel island, bonks cake/frost/brick blocks, stacks bridges, and chases one-more-level energy. Use browser-native procedural textures, kawaii cloud/heart/star motifs, compact meme feedback, catalog-backed fonts/audio/GIFs, large thumb controls, readable HUD pills, and a single self-contained `index.html`.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first first-person sandbox block builder rendered with Three.js.
- objective: explore a small voxel island, mine target blocks, place selected blocks, jump/move safely, and avoid falling below the world.
- input model: touch D-pad for movement, right-side drag for look, large touch buttons for mine/place/jump, inventory slots for block selection, matching mouse/click fallbacks.
- core loop: start game, traverse terrain, raycast-select nearby blocks, mine non-bedrock blocks into inventory, place available blocks adjacent to targeted surfaces, continue creative traversal/building.
- fail/friction state: protected bedrock cannot be mined, placing inside the player is blocked, empty/invalid targets fail feedback, falling below y -15 triggers game over and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- D-pad movement relative to camera yaw with touch/mouse pressed state.
- Right-screen drag look with clamped vertical camera rotation.
- Gravity, jump force, grounded detection, axis-separated collision checks, and fall-loss threshold.
- Raycast block targeting within five units, selection outline, mine/place adjacency semantics.
- Bedrock immunity, inventory gain on mined blocks, non-infinite inventory decrement on placement, infinite starter grass/frost block.
- Start, pause/resume, quit, game-over, restart, sound toggle, sensitivity slider, and mobile-safe CTA paths.

## Remixed target
Snackle Quest: Kawaii Block Builder reframes the same sandbox block-builder loop as a satirical tiny-hero lunch shrine quest. The player is a no-thoughts head-empty snack knight building pastel temple stacks; blocks become frost frosting, cake dirt, and brickone shrine bricks; bonk/stack/boing actions remain identical mechanically while HUD copy, procedural textures, scene motifs, modal identity, audio/GIF feedback, and mobile hierarchy express a kawaii pastel popcore building game with one-more-level energy.
